jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent native RGBA sprite atlas for an isometric Chinese historical RTS.
Reference images are design/style references only, not edit targets. Make a fresh 2 by 2 atlas, one complete independently rendered siege catapult in each cell. Preserve the reference's compact heavy timber chassis, four iron-rimmed wooden spoked wheels, triangular braced uprights, ONE single long pivoted throwing lever ending in one rounded wooden spoon, rear transverse rope winch and dark metal clamps. Brown aged wood, dark iron, tan rope, a single grey rounded rock in the spoon. No people, flags, terrain, labels or shadows on a background. True alpha outside each object.
Four orthographic elevated three-quarter views, all the same machine at the same physical scale. Top left SE: the front throwing-spoon end points diagonally toward screen bottom right; viewer sees the front and its right side. Top right SW: front points diagonally toward screen bottom left; viewer sees front and its left side. Bottom left NE: front points toward screen top right, rear winch/chassis end toward screen bottom left. Bottom right NW: front points toward screen top left, rear winch/chassis end toward screen bottom right. These are separately observed views, not mirrored copies. Keep the rear winch behind the lever pivot, and the front spoon ahead of the pivot, consistently in all views.
All four machines are IDLE READY: throwing arm cocked low toward its front end, rock resting in the spoon, rope taut, wheels stationary. No raised release pose or rock in flight. Dense painterly texture, crisp readable silhouettes and mechanical joints like the reference, coherent soft lighting from upper left. Compact stylized game asset, not a photo or toy. 1024 by 1024 square canvas, four generous separate 512 by 512 cells; every full machine including the low spoon and all wheels fits within its own cell with at least 35 pixels of completely transparent clearance and a wide empty cross gutter. Equal painted machine size and ground-contact baseline per cell. Do not add framing, text, checkerboard, extra levers or hidden disconnected wheel fragments. Save genuinely transparent RGBA.
